title: Northgate Marketplace Guarantee Claim Frequency Rule
content:
**Rule.** Northgate Marketplace Guarantee claims under Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee are counted across all of the buyer's marketplace orders. The count is the number of guarantee claims filed on any marketplace order of the buyer with a filing date in the rolling 12 calendar months ending on the filing date being evaluated, inclusive. When that count has already reached the program's guarantee claims per 12 months figure, a further claim is not decided in customer care but goes to specialist review by a human representative. Claims that were closed because of a card dispute still count.

**Condition, judgement, result.**

| Claims already filed in the window | Judgement | Result for the further claim |
|---|---|---|
| below the program figure | limit not reached | decided in customer care under the guarantee rules |
| at the program figure | limit already reached | goes to specialist review by a human representative |

**Hypothetical illustration.** The programs' figure is 4 claims. A buyer whose orders already carry 4 claims filed in the window, one of them closed because of a card dispute, files a fifth: the fifth goes to specialist review, because the card-dispute closure still counts. With 3 claims in the window, the fourth is decided in customer care.
